title: Printing Presses in the Graphic Arts Collection
lineage: Smithsonian catalog dates Rubel offset for paper to around 1903, describes prior similar work for tin, the press’s operation in 1904 and sale for $5,500 in 1905; inspect catalog pp. 55–57 for scope.
